summary: Open-source payments orchestration platform enabling connectivity to multiple payment providers with intelligent routing, PCI compliance, and cost observability.
usecases: Unified integration with multiple payment gateways (Stripe, Adyen) through a single API for transaction management.
Intelligent payment routing to improve authorization rates and reduce processing costs based on real-time observability.
Building PCI-compliant payment flows for SaaS or self-hosted applications without managing multiple provider integrations.
ideas: Combining with fraud detection APIs for real-time transaction risk scoring.
Creating a white-label payment portal for resellers using hyperswitch's modular components.
Integrating local payment methods in specific regions to expand global e-commerce reach.
